video_title: Matthew Dellavedova Joins The Richard Show | NBA Finals 10-Year Reunion

quotes.speaker: Matthew Dellavedova
quotes.summary_phrase: Matthew Dellavedova on his intense, win-at-all-costs mentality
quotes.excerpt: I've always wanted to win so bad that I'll push as hard as I can to do it.
quotes.quote: I've always wanted to win so bad that I'll push as hard as I can to do it. It's funny having kids now and seeing their different personalities, and some are just at win-at-all-costs.

quotes.speaker: Matthew Dellavedova
quotes.summary_phrase: Matthew Dellavedova on his difficult path to making the NBA
quotes.excerpt: It's hard to make a team as an undrafted guy and then to break into a rotation.
quotes.quote: It's hard to make a team as an undrafted guy and then to break into a rotation. You never know when your chance is going to come, and the season is long. If you can be on a roster, at some point you'll get your shot.

quotes.speaker: Matthew Dellavedova
quotes.summary_phrase: Matthew Dellavedova on LeBron James's physical preparation
quotes.excerpt: Seeing LeBron James, how he takes care of his body and stuff, that's unfair though, bro.
quotes.quote: Seeing LeBron James, how he takes care of his body and stuff, that's unfair though, bro. That's unfair.

quotes.speaker: Matthew Dellavedova
quotes.summary_phrase: Matthew Dellavedova on the difficulty of guarding Stephen Curry
quotes.excerpt: It's an impossible task chasing Stephen Curry around. He never gets tired.
quotes.quote: It's an impossible task chasing Stephen Curry around. He never gets tired. Andrew Bogut, Draymond Green, and David Lee are trying to kill me on screens.

quotes.speaker: Matthew Dellavedova
quotes.summary_phrase: Matthew Dellavedova on the importance of being prepared for opportunities
quotes.excerpt: You have to be ready when your opportunity comes and you have to be a little crazy.
quotes.quote: You have to be ready when your opportunity comes and you have to be a little crazy. You have to prepare like a psycho so that when your opportunity comes, you're ready to win.

quotes.speaker: Matthew Dellavedova
quotes.summary_phrase: Matthew Dellavedova on the preparation required for the NBA Finals
quotes.excerpt: The level of preparation and detail in scouting reports, game planning, and then just the pressure.
quotes.quote: The level of preparation and detail in scouting reports, game planning, and then just the pressure and the circus that comes with it. It's a crazy media circus, and to be able to just focus on your job and turn off the TV is important.

quotes.speaker: Matthew Dellavedova
quotes.summary_phrase: Matthew Dellavedova on the importance of team unity in the playoffs
quotes.excerpt: We were so dialed in as the units, and we knew exactly what we were running.
quotes.quote: We were so dialed in as the units, and we knew exactly what we were running when we got in there, and we went together as a unit. So just being ready to try to change the tempo of the game when we came in and knowing you can go as hard as possible because it's going to be a shorter stint.

quotes.speaker: Matthew Dellavedova
quotes.summary_phrase: Matthew Dellavedova on his transition to venture capital investing
quotes.excerpt: I started investing after I signed in Milwaukee. I had a little extra money, a little extra change.
quotes.quote: I started investing after I signed in Milwaukee. I had a little extra money, a little extra change. My financial advisors wanted to allocate to venture capital, and I was like, what is that? And they said it's like Shark Tank to fast-growing tech companies, and I said, I'm in.
